StatDef.label: armor - scald
StatDef.description:
The protection given against scalding steam and boiling water - a wet burn that armor built for flame or heat does not stop. Only apparel built for it grants this.
Upon taking damage, first this armor rating is reduced by the attack's armor penetration value.
The remaining armor rating is then compared against a random number from 0 to 100.
- If the random number is under half the armor rating, the damage deflects harmlessly. - If the random number is over half the armor rating, but not higher than the armor rating, the damage is reduced by half and changed to blunt. - If the random number is greater than the armor rating, the armor has no effect.
Each layer of armor is applied separately, from the outside in.
